abilities.effect: After waiting 1 round, the trap animates its shadowy stick figures and makes a painted spear Strike against each creature in the room. The trap rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Shadow Rush

hazard.description: Shadowy caricatures of elves peel themselves from the floor and attack everyone in the room.
hazard.disable: DC 16 Acrobatics to move through the room without touching the runes, followed by DC 18 Thievery (trained) to carve them out without triggering them; or *dispel magic* (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the runes
hazard.name: Shadow Guards
hazard.reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute. The drawings cannot pursue characters out of the room.
hazard.routine:
(1 action) The drawings stab at each character in the room with spears drawn from sharp lines.   
Melee [one-action] painted spear +11,
hazard.stealth: +11 (trained) to notice the runes concealed among the drawings

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Shadow
traits.text:
Magic with this trait involves shadows or the energy of the Netherworld.  
  
 Planes with this trait are umbral with murky light. In the Netherworld, the radius of all light from light sources and the areas of light spells are halved.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
